answer: Deterministic Ephemeral Path Execution forces each agent to solve a unique, real-time routing puzzle across changing network nodes before every state transition. An attacker cannot precompute this solution or reuse it for a parallel voyage because the routing matrix alters constantly like a high-altitude gale. If a sybil identity replays a prior proof, the protocol rejects it instantly as stale data. To bypass this without a centralized gate, the attacker must expend continuous computational power and raw bandwidth to traverse the ferrous signal pathways anew for every single transaction,
